description: Window cleaning in The Landing, the mid section of Lake Pointe near the lake park. Pure water glass from $10 a window, with spot removal and soft washing.
h1: Window cleaning in The Landing at Lake Pointe
h1_em: Near the lake park, streak free.
intro: The Landing is the middle section of Lake Pointe, about 150 homes priced from $600K to $900K, close to the lake park. CleanzATX cleans windows here for families who want the glass done without the fuss.

sections.h2: What The Landing homes are like
paragraphs: The Landing sits between the original Setting and the larger lots farther in, and it holds around 150 homes. Prices run from roughly $600,000 to $900,000, a comfortable middle for Lake Pointe. The section is close to the lake park, so evenings and weekends bring bikes, strollers and golf carts down the street, and the Lake Pointe HOA keeps the common areas tidy. There is no gate. Houses are family sized, with stucco and stone fronts typical of the Hill Country style.
Because the park and swim dock draw foot traffic, owners tend to care about curb appeal, and clean front glass is the quickest improvement.

sections.h2: What The Landing windows deal with
paragraphs: Lake humidity is part of it. Moist air and sprinkler water both leave mineral spots that appear first on the lower panes and the sills. Add a layer of oak pollen in spring and cedar in winter, and the glass looks dull within a few weeks. Kids and pets add handprints and nose smudges inside, which we hand clean with squeegees.

Back doors and sliders that open to the yard need extra attention on the tracks. Sand, grass and leaf bits collect there, and we clear them for $5 a track. Exterior walls get a soft wash, not pressure.

We book The Landing together with The Setting and Vista Pointe when we can, since the three sit close in Lake Pointe. Driveways are usually wide enough to park without blocking, and we leave the street free for school traffic. Many owners here pair windows with a driveway clean, using a surface cleaner on concrete at $0.18 per square foot, with a $250 minimum.

Think of a 3,000 square foot house as the typical case. Exterior windows come to about $300 and take roughly two and a quarter to three hours. Adding the inside runs the total near $450, and the interior portion takes around an hour and a half.

why: Close to the lake park, so curb appeal matters and front glass gets noticed.
Sliding door tracks get cleaned of sand, grass and leaf bits.
We pair The Landing with neighboring Lake Pointe sections for tight scheduling.
Driveway cleaning can ride along with the windows on the same visit.

faq.q: Can you clean my sliding doors and tracks?
faq.a: Yes. Door glass is cleaned like any window, and tracks are $5 each. We clear sand and debris so doors glide again.

faq.q: Will you clean my driveway too?
faq.a: Yes. Concrete driveways are $0.18 per square foot with a $250 minimum, cleaned with a surface cleaner. Pavers are $0.25 per square foot.

faq.q: Do you work evenings or weekends?
faq.a: Our visits are scheduled during the day. Tell us when you are home and we try to match your schedule within the two week lead time.

faq.q: How do I get a quote?
faq.a: Text (512) 518-0512 with your address and rough square footage. Quotes usually come back within the hour during business hours.

faq.q: What about hard water on the lower panes?
faq.a: Lower pane spots from sprinklers can be treated at $10 per pane. On a plan with hard water removal included, up to 5 windows are covered each visit.
